patch_description:
This version preserves the strongest parts of the current scheduler: exact search for small workloads, objective-based beam search, adaptive impact-guided neighborhoods, insertion, swap, reversal, and block-relocation local search.

It additionally crossovers the beam-based construction with deterministic greedy insertion constructions. Beam search only appends transactions, while greedy insertion evaluates every valid insertion point in a partial schedule using the real simulator cost. This can construct schedules that append-only beam search cannot reach early enough. The resulting insertion-built schedules are added as diverse local-search seeds alongside beam and perturbation seeds.

Step-by-step:
1. Cache all simulator evaluations by immutable transaction tuple.
2. Solve workloads with at most seven transactions exactly.
3. Build high-quality append-based beam schedules.
4. Build additional schedules by greedily choosing the transaction and insertion location with minimum actual partial makespan.
5. Perturb leading beam schedules with reversals, block moves, and endpoint exchanges.
6. Improve every seed using objective-evaluated insertion, swap, reversal, and short block relocation moves.
7. Return the best valid permutation found.
